svg.text: (c) Standard QR (byte mode, level M) with a sidecar: glyph, species band, pair strip
Station size: a 300 px plate, the code 264 px across (the QR 200 px plus its sidecar)
QR version 1, 21 modules, 0.95 mm a module at 20 mm
QR version 2, 25 modules, 0.80 mm a module at 20 mm
future · 150 open loci, 5 of 8 chapters read
QR version 4, 33 modules, 0.61 mm a module at 20 mm
Caddy print: 20 mm at 203 dpi with thermal dot gain, every printer dot shown 2 × 2
Relatedness, glowtail at 300 px: the child holds one of the mother's copies (top or inner) and one of the father's (bottom or outer) at every locus
